title: GRAIL finds large lunar caverns and lava tubes

tellings.quote:
But NASA has also um
imaged the subsurface of the moon using
a probe called Grail

plain: NASA has mapped what lies under the Moon's surface with a probe called GRAIL and found large caverns and lava tubes, which are long tunnels left behind by flowing lava. A researcher who is a guest on the episode, and is not named, says this without giving a source, in an episode about what NASA may be keeping quiet about the Moon. His point is that the Moon may hold large hollow spaces beneath its surface.
